a.lede: Control Resonant's warped Manhattan cityscape pushes graphics cards to the max thanks to path-traced lighting effects and full support for Nvidia's DLSS 4.5 technologies. We put it to the test to see how it performs on 28 graphics cards from Nvidia, AMD, and Intel.
a.title: Control Resonant PC performance tested: 28 GPUs take us back to the Oldest House and a warped Manhattan cityscape

b.lede: The developers of RPCS3 have found a workaround for an Nvidia driver bug and are touting up to 37% performance gains.
b.title: PlayStation 3 emulation devs work around an Nvidia bug for up to 37% faster performance — open-source coders reach out to Nvidia to over uncovered bug
